name: Health
description: Workouts, sleep, activity and nutrition from your logs: the Health page, and sleep, activity and meals blocks for Today.
author: Vaultite

workouts.description: an area's workouts: its weeks and latest sessions, with each lift's top set and the top grade when its logs have them

area.description: the area whose workouts it shows (a slug of the vault's areas)

sleep.description: last night's sleep (its stages when the Watch measured them) and the average over the last nights

nights.description: how many nights the average covers

activity.description: today's steps, energy and exercise, the latest resting heart rate, HRV and VO2 max, and a week of steps (Apple Health's day logs)

days.description: how many days of steps it shows

workout.description: in a workout log file: its exercises and sets, or its climbs
